description:
Di Swan City (kota baru), Exit toll Cikupa di Tangerang. Tidak jauh dari Jakarta (45 min aja) dan 20 min dari Karawaci.

Kira-kira 15 km dari pantai dan 15 meter di atas permukaan laut, ada Perumahan Grand Cluster Lavon 2, Cluster Montana. Type G, smart living home. Banjir aman!

Kerena, nanti ada "exit toll baru" (sudah mulai construction) dan juga jalan raya (JORR III = Jakarta Outer Ring Road) ke Soekarno-Hatta airport. Dan juga MRT stations di Bitung -- Curug -- Cikupa -- Balaraja.

Swan City will be a "city of the future" with shopping malls, universities en hospitals. This development will increase your investment in this rumah.

Sangat cocok untuk: bujangan (pilot atau pramugari), tetapi juga cocok untuk pria dan wanita yang baru menikah. Cocok juga untuk entrepreneur: work from home as webdesigner, digitale marketing consultant, financial advisor or stock trader.  This house is equipped with fast-internet from Firstmedia, which has the best fast internet connection.

Jessica in the movie 'Home Sweet Loan' said: "Having a house will give me peace of mind when I'm old." 
But don't buy in Jakarta. Mahal! Banjir!

Beli dan berikan rumah ini sebagai hadiah untuk anak-anak Anda. Atau beli untuk isteri. Tidak perlu repot-repot untuk melakukan perbaikan rumah. Cek foto-fotonya. Sudah beres! Kondisi rumah sangat baik.

Get the key and live luxuriously, like a king & queen. Enhance the quality of your life and buy this house.
Or buy this house as an investment property: "buy low now, sell high later". Tarif Trump (presiden USA) bergerak mendorong orang Indonesia menuju emas dan real estat. Ayo, beli sekarang rumah ini!

All necessary improvements with highest quality checks have been done. This house is in excellent state, well-maintained (walls outside, painted on 6 september 2025) and very very safe.

Close by (walking distance) is an Indomart, a clubhouse, a swimming pool, a gym and a 80-hectare Kedaton golf court (10 min by car). 
Enjoy jogging and cycling or other outdoor activities di Lavon2.

Ada shuttle bus juga, ke Jakarta: naik di tankstation Shell.

Safe and healthy environment for children: "Kualitas udara di Lavon sangat sehat (bukan polusi di Lavon)". 
Just around the corner is the senior high school 'Laurensia'.

The design of Cluster Lavon and the premium facilities makes social interaction with other residents and neighbors very easy: clubhouse, swimming pool, sports club and children's playgrounds. 

Daftar interior (classic style dan semua furnitur berkualitas premium):

Finally, 3 m tangga lipat teleskopik for access to windows outside (buat bersihkan kaca).

Also: smart home concept for modern lifestyle, comfort and safety: internal CCTV + smart digital lock on the front door. 

Premium electricity facility by PLN. Listrik rumah sudah upgrade to 5500 Watt.
